verdict.rationale: Docs claim centralized visibility across pipeline status, testing policies, and deployment environments organization-wide (bitbucket-docs-8), plus policy/permission enforcement across teams and repos (bitbucket-docs-6, bitbucket-docs-7), which supports the devops-lead visibility story. However, there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of a dedicated org-wide CI/CD dashboard, and community evidence is silent on this specific capability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the centralized dashboard UI, detail on cross-repo/cross-workspace rollup reporting, and any community confirmation of this feature working at scale.
